# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 73 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 73 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_073_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 8, Part 4 — The Rods Returned and the Sealing

**73:1** "Lord," I asked, "what about those who gave up green rods and whose rods were found green — who are they?" "These," he said, "are those who always feared God and guarded his commandments and did not swerve at any point. They are the ones who will live in the first tower."

**73:2** After he had completed the exposition of all the rods, he said to me: "Go and tell all people to repent, and they will live to God. Because the Lord, being full of compassion, sent me to give repentance to all — though especially to those who have sinned greatly. For the Lord is willing that everyone who was called by his great and holy name should be saved."

**73:3** After he had finished speaking with me, the two young men who had been with him came and they carried him away and led him back, toward the east. And he was laughing as he departed. And he called to me as he went away and said: "Struggle well."

**73:4** Then I awoke and wrote down everything that was shown to me, and I was gladdened, for the things which were shown to me were great and glorious. And when I woke up I said: "The Lord has not forgotten me, but showed me his grace."

---

*EMET renders the Greek of P.Mich. 130 with maximal literalness, preserving the conclusion of the rod-vision and the commission in Similitude 8.*
